First, note that in 1670, time zones were not standardized, but for the purpose of this exercise, we assume modern time zone offsets from UTC.

Asia/Tokyo is UTC+9.
Asia/Kolkata is UTC+5:30.

UTC+9 at 07:00 means UTC is 22:00 previous day (July 31, 1670).
UTC to Kolkata (UTC+5:30) adds 5 hours 30 minutes: 22:00 + 5:30 = 03:30 next day.

So date becomes August 1, 1670, 03:30 in Kolkata.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1670-08-01 03:30
